messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: sustained 5xx spike on /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1) starting ~2250001200. Auto-paging oncall.
beth_oncall: seeing it, pulling up metrics. 5xxs are mostly 503/504 from gpu-backend-3. Queue length on the embedding workers spiked.
sam_engineer: I'm on it — will join call in 2. quick check: is this affecting hosted customers only or dedicated too?
ash_cs: we have a couple of customers reporting high latencies (ACME, BrightDocs). CS is fielding support tickets now.
beth_oncall: looks like hosted API only, routing shows a traffic surge from an unnamed client doing large-batch embeddings. concurrency + long sequences.
ops-bot: Runbook triggered: "embeddings_high_503". Suggested mitigations: 1) throttle per-route concurrency, 2) temporarily reduce per-customer batch size, 3) fail fast on large requests.
sam_engineer: I'll patch a quick quota tweak. Plan: reduce global embeddings concurrency from 600 -> 250 for 30m, and add per-route rate-limiting rule to cap /v1/embeddings to 30 rps across EU region. Apply now?
beth_oncall: yes, apply — notify CS and customers. Also consider disabling rerank fallback to reduce load if it's chaining calls.
leo_infra: push incoming: command I will run: ``POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/limits/update
{
  "route":"/v1/embeddings",
  "region":"eu-west-1",
  "global_concurrency":250,
  "max_batch_size":64,
  "window_seconds":30
}``
(I'll use the admin key via vault)
ash_cs: thanks — I've posted a customer advisory in #customer-status for ACME and BrightDocs: "We're seeing degraded embeddings performance in EU; engineering working on rate-limiting to stabilize. We'll update in 15m." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
beth_oncall: after we throttle, we should also bump chat/rerank quotas for critical customers if we throttle embeddings (to avoid downstream errors). Which endpoints are safe to raise?
sam_engineer: chat is cheap on our newer io-optimized pools; we can temporarily increase chat burst for PRO customers: per-customer chat_qps +20% and priority routing to chat-pool-2. For rerank, recommend disabling non-critical rerank retries (set max_retries=0) rather than full disable.
pagerduty-bot: @beth_oncall acknowledged the alert and escalated to engineering lead.
leo_infra: throttle applied: /v1/embeddings concurrency=250, EU rps cap=30, max_batch_size=64. Taking effect now. Rolling back rule in 30m unless we see sustained improvement.
beth_oncall: seeing drop in queue length, 5xx rate falling. Nice. Keep monitoring for 5m and confirm error budget.
sam_engineer: pushing follow-up: added per-customer soft quota for high-ingress keys: if key > 1000 reqs/min -> 429 with message "quota temporary: heavy usage; try smaller batches or retry in 60s". Config snippet: ``if (key.rate>1000) return 429;``
ash_cs: CS will advise ACME to reduce batch_size to 32 and enable async batching. They accepted temporary changes.
beth_oncall: also set a route-specific circuit-breaker for rerank chains: if average latency > 1500ms for 2 consecutive minutes -> route rerank->disabled for 10m. This prevents cascading failures.
sam_engineer: logs: ``gpu-backend-3 OOM at 2250001216 for job id=job_87a3; large-batch 2048 vectors.`` So large batch sizes were the main cause.
leo_infra: we should add a pre-validate on request size in the edge to reject >1024 vectors with a helpful error rather than let it hit GPUs.
beth_oncall: agree. Ticketing: create follow-up engineering story to add edge pre-validation + per-route default max_batch_size enforcement.
ash_cs: customers updated. No new high-severity tickets. ACME reports partial recovery.
sam_engineer: plan for next steps: 1) keep throttles for 30m, 2) roll out edge pre-validation as hotfix after incident, 3) schedule capacity increase or smarter batching recommendations for high-volume customers.
beth_oncall: handing off to night oncall — @leo_infra take final watch. If 5xx stays <1% for 30m, mark incident resolved. Oncall notes added to runbook channel.
leo_infra: taking over. Will escalate if we see >3% 5xx or queue growth. Good job team :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident "embeddings_eu_503_spike" updated: status=mitigated; mitigation=per-route throttles/per-customer soft quotas; owner=leo_infra.
beth_oncall: closing thread from my side after 45m monitoring window. Final note: learned to set stricter default per-route limits for embeddings vs chat; add product guidance for customers on recommended max batch sizes."
